prerequisites: Minimum 7 years of school knowledge in the foreign language.

learning_outcomes.text: Students who have successfully completed this module generally possess foreign language skills comparable to level C1 according to the CEFR (Common European Framework of Reference for Languages).
Students who have successfully completed this module know and master the confident use of international negotiation techniques.
Students who have successfully completed this module recognize the general importance of emotional intelligence and are aware of its positive value for leaders and companies.

Students who have successfully completed this module have profound knowledge of essential aspects of intercultural communication and can successfully apply this knowledge in international negotiations.
Students who have successfully completed this module can explain or reflect on various basic communication techniques and utilize their potential to better cope with themselves and others.
Students who have successfully completed this module are capable of negotiating complex subject-specific content competently and expressively in the foreign language.
Students who have successfully completed this module are effective in both interpersonal and professional communication, as they possess emotional intelligence and intercultural sensitivity.

syllabus_topics: Intensive training of technical communication skills in an international setting
Case studies to practise fundamentals of negotiation
Basic Neuro-Linguistic Programming (NLP) concepts and techniques
The power of emotional intelligence for leaders and organisations
Six tools for clear communication: The Hamburg Approach
assessment_rules: The graded examination is a presentation (with written elaboration). The presentation duration is approximately 20-25 minutes, with an accompanying written elaboration of approximately 4-5 pages.
